intent.raw: Refine a plan for finishing goal and promote the learning package.
intent.objective: Create a confirmation-gated promotion plan for reading-learning-package that finishes candidate evidence, adds registry discoverability, validates generated runtime surfaces, and preserves submodule-first publishing.
intent.operator_sentence: refine a plan for finishing goal and promote the learning package

route_menu.context_hint: The target is already implemented and Spellcraft-reviewed as a reusable candidate. Promotion should be a governed release plan, not another runtime implementation pass.

items.label: Promotion Readiness Plan
items.description: Plan registry exposure, generated runtime mirrors, validation receipts, and submodule-safe publication.

items.label: Direct Registry Patch
items.description: Patch the spell registry immediately. Rejected because generated surfaces and publish gates still need a plan.

items.label: New Runtime Work
items.description: Add more implementation features. Rejected because current blocker is promotion governance, not runtime behavior.

technique_overlays.trigger: Promotion requires ordered evidence flow from current spell candidate to registry and publish gates.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes a prior artifact or concrete repository path and preserves owner boundaries.

technique_overlays.trigger: The spell is a reusable candidate and needs discoverability plus generated runtime surface validation before promotion.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Promotion can only proceed when registry, runtime mirrors, validation receipts, and publication gates are named.

technique_overlays.trigger: The public arcanum submodule, private parent gitlink, generated mirrors, and learning outputs have different authorities.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The plan must keep public spell promotion, private parent updates, and generated learning output authority separate.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The promotion plan is source-local and deterministic. Subagents are not needed until a later execution run chooses to parallelize registry review, bootstrap validation, and publication checks.

native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Build bounded context from README, VALIDATION, VALIDATION-EXPERIMENT, fixture reports, registry, and bootstrap script.
Produce final non-executed promotion work-pack after upstream review stages run.

steps.name: Build Promotion Evidence Baseline
stop_conditions: Block if current spell contract, validation report, fixture report, registry, or bootstrap script cannot be read.
Flag if generated mirror state is ambiguous and must be resolved by dry-run.

steps.name: Define Promotion Delta
stop_conditions: Block if promotion would imply source-claim promotion or ownership drift.
Flag if the promotion name, aliases, or registry purpose need maintainer choice.

steps.name: Review Promotion Blockers
stop_conditions: Block on missing registry acceptance criteria, generated surface criteria, or publication receipt criteria.
Flag optional PDF renderer integration as future work, not promotion blocker.

steps.name: Record Research Decision
stop_conditions: Ask before any external research is introduced.
Block if external research is treated as stronger than repository evidence.

steps.name: Select Smallest Promotion Unit
stop_conditions: Block if the selected unit bundles unrelated spell changes.
Flag generated mirrors for profile-specific handling rather than source contract expansion.

steps.name: Design Promotion Patch Set
stop_conditions: Block if design requires mutating research-tower or whisper contracts.
Flag parent generated mirrors as parent-scope synchronization, not public spell source.

steps.name: Review Promotion Design
stop_conditions: Block if registry row, generated surfaces, validation bundle, or publication gates are missing.
Flag optional alias choices for maintainer review if aliases are added.

steps.name: Repair And Validate Promotion Scope
stop_conditions: Block if the promotion unit no longer recomposes into the original learning package objective.
Flag any remaining non-blocking residue with owner and next route.

steps.name: Produce Non-Executed Promotion Plan
stop_conditions: Block mutation-capable promotion until operator confirms.
Flag if make bump-check cannot run because unrelated workspace dirt needs isolation.

steps.name: Final Refine Synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if final synthesis claims promotion was executed.
Flag any deferred publication or parent-gitlink work.

gates.condition: Runtime-backed refine stages and any mutation-capable promotion work require explicit confirmation.
Promotion must not promote generated learning packages, tower claims, or source vocabulary into canonical authority.
Registry row must include purpose, composed sigils, use-when text, and link to the spell README.
Bootstrap dry-run or temporary-target install must prove reading-learning-package resolves as a selected spell.
Commit and push arcanum before parent gitlink; run make bump-check before parent push.

authority.execution: task-session owns any future mutation-capable work units
authority.validation: experiment-harness and spellcraft own reusable behavior validation
authority.evidence: refine indexes source evidence and planned receipts
authority.promotion: arcanum registry and generated mirrors require explicit promotion commit

state_namespaces.write_policy: Spell source, runtime, validation, and development evidence live under the public spell package.
Registry discoverability changes require promotion validation and maintainer acceptance.
Generated mirrors are synchronized only after temporary-target or dry-run validation proves the expected output set.
Parent gitlink updates happen only after the public arcanum commit is pushed and make bump-check passes.

promotion_splits.rule: Push arcanum first, then parent after make bump-check.
Generated package outputs are evidence fixtures only, never canonical source authority.

promotion_guardrails: No external research during promotion planning.
No source-authority change to research-tower or whisper.
No parent gitlink commit before arcanum commit is pushed.
No registry promotion claim without live validation receipts.
